summary: Frontend-only mobile regression run executed on public URL at 390x844 and 375x667 with synthetic sessions. Core auth/session, location search, weather display, assistant send/history, diagnosis no-photo validation, and screenshots were validated; several marketplace/diary/workboard flows remain blocked by modal viewport/tapability issues.

ui_bugs.issue: Expo logs still show repeated runtime error: 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>' with stack at src/screens/Home.tsx:26 despite prior guard fixes.

ui_bugs.component: Create listing / Diary / Listing detail modals
ui_bugs.issue: Primary modal actions frequently become non-tappable at 390x844 (outside viewport): calendar day selection, diary save/delete confirm, listing respond, etc. Requires manual wheel scrolling workarounds and still flaky.

integration_issues.issue: Could not complete all requested marketplace/work-board scenarios (create via UI calendar, owner accept/decline + renter cancel + privacy matrix) due modal viewport interaction blockers and intermittent no-listing state.

issues: Critical actions frequently render below visible/tappable area at 390x844, reducing form usability.
Modal interaction reliability depends on manual scroll/wheel workarounds.

react_native_issues.issue: Unexpected text-node runtime violation still emitted from Home render path in Expo logs.

action_items: Fix remaining 'Unexpected text node' runtime error in Home render path (actual production/web bundle still emits it).
Fix modal viewport/tapability for critical buttons and date cells at 390x844/375x667 (create listing, diary save/delete, listing respond).
After modal fix, re-run blocked flows: tool listing create with calendar, my listing close/reopen, owner accept/decline + renter cancel, request privacy, workboard two-sided interest and decisions.
Re-verify calendar grid usability (7-column day selection) and complete crop-add/deletion validations without scroll hacks.
critical_code_review_comments: app/_layout.tsx uses LogBox.ignoreAllLogs(true), which hides runtime warnings/errors during QA and can mask production regressions.
Several long single-line JSX return blocks reduce maintainability/debuggability and made text-node RCA difficult under minified bundles.
Home runtime stack traces from Expo logs indicate unresolved RN text rendering violation despite prior boolean guard changes.
seed_data_creation: Created/rotated synthetic UI sessions for TEST_user_ui_owner and TEST_user_ui_other; created one TEST_UI_SEEDED_TOOL_REQ listing via public API to unblock request-form capture.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use fresh synthetic session tokens (owner/other) since signout invalidates tokens. Request-form screenshot now exists. Avoid repeating selector retries for listing-start-date-day and diary modal buttons without first fixing modal viewport behavior.
rca_of_issue: Repro for critical runtime: authenticate -> open Home; Expo logs repeatedly emit 'Unexpected text node: .' with stack at Home.tsx:26. Repro for usability blocker: at 390x844 open Sheet modals (listing/diary/detail) and try pressing lower actions/date cells; Playwright reports element outside viewport even with force click, requiring wheel scroll and still flaky. Mitigation: ensure modal scroll container reliably exposes actionable controls inside viewport and verify RN text nodes are never emitted outside <Text>.
